hook.name: KlikHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Klik.finance that implements market-cap-tiered swap fees for token launch pools. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims during beforeSwap/afterSwap and distributed to a platform treasury and token creator. Includes anti-sniping protection that locks trades on the deployment block and caps buy amounts in USD during the first few blocks.
